locations.title: Faculty House 2nd Floor
locations.description:
Known for its delightful lunch featuring globally inspired cuisine, Faculty House emphasizes regionally grown and locally sourced ingredients. Student dining is open on the 2nd Floor for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

At breakfast, for one swipe pick 4 items to get your day going: Coffee, OJ, breakfast sandwich, oatmeal, yogurt parfait, or fruit cup. 

Lunch and dinner feature a main dish, pasta, a vegan entrée, plus a starch, veggie, salad, fruit and dessert! Click each menu below for details.

Faculty House accepts Dining Plan swipes, Dining Dollars and Flex Dollars. 

Menus are subject to change. For the most accurate allergen information, refer to the printed in-unit menus.

locations.title: Grace Dodge Dining Hall
locations.address: Teachers College, 525 W 120th St, New York, NY 10027
locations.description:
Located in the lower level of Grace Dodge Hall at Teachers College, this location offers a set number of items in exchange for a meal swipe, or payable by Dining Dollars, Flex, or credit card. 

Menus are subject to change. For the most accurate allergen information, refer to the printed in-unit menus.

Here's the Deal

For one meal swipe, or payable by Dining Dollars, Flex, or credit card, you get an entree from the salad station, hot station, or grill, plus a hand fruit, dessert, and beverage (hot coffee or freestyle machine).

locations.title: JJ's Place
locations.description:
JJ’s Place is the casual and comfortable weekend and late-night destination serving burgers and other specialty sandwiches plus fries, smoothies, wings, and more. Located in the lower level of John Jay Hall.

JJ's Take 4

Need to restock the snacks in your room, or want to grab some goodies for later? Use an extra meal swipe and take 4 items from the shelves by the cashier station in JJ's. Items include granola bars, nuts, pop tarts, hot and cold cereal cups, chips, yogurt, and more.

Menus are subject to change. For the most accurate allergen information, refer to the printed in-unit menus.

locations.title: John Jay Dining Hall
locations.description:
Just like home food favorites, made fresh daily. Special orders at the grill or features at the hot entrée station, plus pasta, international fusions, house-made soups, smoothies, and rotating Chef features. Kosher to-go counter at the main entrance. Located in John Jay on the first floor.

Food service is continuous during operational hours, with specific meal items served at the following times:

  • Breakfast: 9:30 a.m. - 11:00 a.m., with breakfast items available at the grill until 2:00 p.m.
  • Lunch: 11:00 a.m. - 2:30 p.m., with Pasta, Bao, Action, Soup and Salad Stations open until 5:00 p.m.
  • Dinner: 5:00 p.m. - close

Menus are subject to change. For the most accurate allergen information, refer to the printed in-unit menus.

locations.title: Johnny's Food Truck
locations.description:
Brought to you by the culinary team at John Jay: come get your bowl on at Johnny’s, serving lunch and dinner at the John Jay Gate! 

Here’s the Deal 

For one meal swipe, you get: 

  • One traditional or vegan entrée bowl (lunch) or burrito (dinner)
  • One piece of fruit
  • One dessert
  • Gluten-free options available by request
     

A water station will be available at the truck. Bring your own reusable bottle or grab a compostable to-go cup with your meal. 

Hours may vary for inclement weather and academic breaks. Check the website for daily updates.

locations.title: Robert F. Smith Dining Hall
locations.address: Henry R. Kravis Hall 655 W 130th St, New York, NY 10027
locations.description:
Located in the Henry R. Kravis Hall at Columbia Business School, the Robert F. Smith Dining Hall is the go-to eatery for business school students, staff, and faculty.

Open Monday – Thursday, 8:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.,  Friday 8:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m. with food service available at the following times:

  • Continental breakfast: 8:00 a.m. – 11:00 a.m.
  • Lunch: 11:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m.
  • Snacks & grab-and-go items: 2:00 p.m. – 4:00/4:30 p.m.
  • Coffee bar: all day

This location does not accept Columbia Dining meal swipes. Payment is by Flex or credit card only.

Menus are subject to change. For the most accurate allergen information, refer to the printed in-unit menus.

locations.title: The Fac Shack
locations.description:
Located in the Wien Courtyard, the Fac Shack food truck is a convenient, grab-and-go lunch option on east campus. This location offers a set number of items in exchange for a meal swipe, or payable by Dining Dollars, Flex, or credit card. Lunch includes an entrée, hand fruit, dessert, and water (refill station).

New, Spring 2026: You asked for more variety at Fac Shack, and we hear you. This spring semester, Fac Shack will embark on a culinary World Tour, featuring a new global cuisine each week! The rotating menu will spotlight dishes from around the world, giving students something new to look forward to every time they stop by.

Menus are subject to change. For the most accurate allergen information, refer to the printed in-unit menus.
